description: Use this skill when a user asks to polish, rewrite, humanize, de-AI, localize, or oralize Chinese writing, including short-video scripts, articles, social posts, speeches, newsletters, and personal-IP content. The skill diagnoses “AI味”, preserves the user's meaning, adapts to optional style samples, replaces translation-like phrasing with natural Chinese expression, and outputs a polished version plus concise revision notes.
